observations: Photo 0 shows an orange LPG gas cylinder with black protective mesh netting wrapped around the body, outdoors in a market setting.
A brass valve is visible on top, uncapped, with a red plastic cap resting loosely on it.
A small black logo/symbol is molded or painted on the cylinder shoulder but is not legible as a brand name.
Photo 1 is a top-down view showing the valve and a hand-written black marker 'MX' on the cylinder dome.
No stamped manufacturer plate, tare weight, water capacity, or test/manufacture date is legible in either photo.
Cylinder appears unused/new in finish (paint and netting intact), but there is no gas gauge or fill indicator visible.
No scale, regulator, or burning stove shown to demonstrate actual gas content or function.

claims.evidence: No stamped capacity or tare weight marking is legible in photo 0 or photo 1; size is only the seller's stated word.
No country-of-origin stamp, maker's plate, or import marking visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Actual water capacity may not be 12kg
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped collar/shoulder markings showing tare weight (W) and water capacity (WC)
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified capacity, treated as standard/generic size cylinder rather than premium foreign 12kg

risks.risk: Cylinder could be empty or only partially filled
risks.proof: Photo of a weighing scale with the cylinder on it, or a clip of gas flowing from a connected regulator/stove
risks.if_unproven: priced as empty cylinder only, no gas value included

risks.risk: Valve could be faulty or leaking
risks.proof: Close-up clip of soap-bubble leak test on the valve threads under pressure
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve condition unverified, worst case needing replacement

risks.risk: Cylinder could be past its safety test/recertification date or old stock relabelled as new
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped manufacture/test date on the shoulder
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified age, not assumed new despite fresh paint

risks.risk: 'Foreign' claim could just be marketing; could be a refurbished or repainted local cylinder
risks.proof: Photo of maker's plate or country-of-origin stamp
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard local-market cylinder, no import premium

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the stamped shoulder/collar markings (tare weight, water capacity, manufacture/test date, country of origin)
Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale to confirm it is filled/empty and its actual kg
Short video/photo of a soap-bubble leak test on the valve
Photo of any maker's plate confirming import origin
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a gas cylinder in good cosmetic condition, but capacity, fill state, valve integrity, and origin are all unverified from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst-case (unverified size, empty, unverified condition, no import premium).
